# Core Loot Manager

formerly Classic Loot Manager

[Lint](https://github.com/ClassicLootManager/ClassicLootManager) [Release](https://github.com/ClassicLootManager/ClassicLootManager/releases) [Issues](https://github.com/ClassicLootManager/ClassicLootManager/issues) [Discord](https://discord.gg/Qjn8KdD8yt) [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/classiclootmanager)

# About

Core Loot Manager is a robust Loot Tracking and awarding tool for guilds.
It's designed to superseed old DKP and EPGP AddOns and it's derivatives and solves it's biggest painpoints by focusing on optimial communication and storage.
CLM implements Event Sourcing and MVC programming models to achieve those targets. All data is synchronised automatically.

**Core Loot Manager does not use officer notes to store any data.**

## Wiki

Be sure to check our [Wiki](https://github.com/ClassicLootManager/ClassicLootManager/wiki) for lots of information.

## Point Systems

Core Loot Manager currently supports **DKP** and **EPGP** . There are also mechanisms for utilizing DKP as **SK** which you can run at the same time!

## Auto synchronisation within Guild

## Cross-guild synchronisation

## Multiple roster (teams) support

With CLM unconquered scalability, you can run multiple DKP, EPGP and SK systems in your guild, even at the same time!

## Multiple item auction

CLM allows to auction virtually any amount of items during single auction.

## Alt-main linking

## Profile locking

If you want to block some players from receiving points or being charged for items just lock their profile!

## Mulit-level Access Control

...

## Multiple simultaneous Raids management

* Raid management and auto-creating profiles and filling roster when initializing raid
* Multi-level logging for better issue handling

## Administration

* Auditing UI - Check and manage all events that happened in the addon
* Time travel mode - correct errors and add entries in history to keep the data in place

## Utilities

* Built-in migration from MonolithDKP, EssentialDKP, **CommunityDKP** , BastionLoot and **CEPGP**
* Loot tracking queue for fast auctioning
* Auto-posting loot to raid channel
* Player role tracking
* DKP and GP price information on tooltip

## External integrations

* [WoW DKP Discord Bot integration](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=http%253a%252f%252ftiny.one%252fwowdkpbot-discord)
* [Gargul integration](https://github.com/papa-smurf/Gargul) for easy TMB-input
* [RCLootCouncil integration](https://github.com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil_Classic) for even easier LC + EPGP/DKP combination
* XML and JSON Exporting

## Description

Fork of Classic Loot Manager. Original version : <https://github.com/CoreLootManager/CoreLootManager>

This addon is a patch to fix compatibility issues, and add new features, with WoW TBC Anniversary (Interface 20505).

\-----

Installation Guide ( **IMPORTANT** )

**English**

**Requirements**  
\- World of Warcraft TBC Anniversary (2.5.5)
\- **No additional addons required - all dependencies are included** (Delete Ace if previously installed)

**Installation**

1\. Close World of Warcraft completely

2\. Locate your AddOns folder

3\. Remove old version (if exists) or uninstall it from the CurseForge application

4\. Install **Classic Loot Manager (TBC Anniversary)** from CurseForge

5\. Launch World of Warcraft

6\. Enable the addon

7\. Verify installation  
\- Type `/clm` in chat (or use minimap button) - the addon menu should appear

**Troubleshooting**

Addon doesn't appear in the list :  
\- Make sure the folder is named exactly `ClassicLootManager-TBC`  
\- Verify the `.toc` file is directly inside the folder (not in a subfolder)

Lua errors on load :  
\- Type `/console scriptErrors 1` to see error messages  
\- Make sure you're using the patched version (v1.9.2-TBC)

Conflicts with other addons :  
\- This patched version fixes conflicts with Nova World Buffs, Pally Power, and Qwartz
\- If issues persist, try disabling other addons one by one to identify conflicts

\---

excerpts:
Loot Council and Wishlist treat new raiders fairly by default.
5. ### What's your average raid roster turnover?
   
   High turnover guilds (>30% per tier) should run EPGP or Wishlist; the system has to absorb new raiders without manual rebalancing. Low-turnover guilds can run DKP or Loot Council without churn pain.

## Addon and tooling reality

Every system above has at least one mature addon. The administrative overhead is in officer training, not the addon.

DKP
    Core Loot Manager (CLM) is the current default in 2025-2026 Classic raiding and supports DKP, EPGP, and roll modes from a single config. MonolithDKP and CommunityDKP still work but most active guilds have migrated off them.

EPGP
    EPGP Lootmaster (classic) or RCLootCouncil with EPGP module (retail). Wowaudit can drive automatic decay and import.

Loot Council
    RCLootCouncil. Universal. Add the wowaudit integration for sim data, alts, and historical context inline at award time.
